meaning.en: meditating on the self as an unbroken circle
meaning.hi: आत्मा को अखंड मंडल रूप में ध्याते हुए

meaning.en: self-shining, holding the whole universe within it
meaning.hi: स्वप्रकाशित, सम्पूर्ण ब्रह्मांड को धारण किए

meaning.en: the Goddess-teacher is the power behind every cause
meaning.hi: श्रीगुरु सभी कारणों की मूल शक्ति हैं

meaning.en: the body takes the form of nine openings
meaning.hi: देह नौ द्वारों के रूप में है

meaning.en: the nine powers form the Shri Chakra
meaning.hi: नौ शक्तियाँ श्रीचक्र बनाती हैं

meaning.en: Varahi as the ancestral, protecting form
meaning.hi: वाराही पितृ-रूपा

meaning.en: Kurukulla, the mother, deity of offering
meaning.hi: कुरुकुल्ला माता, बलि-देवता

meaning.en: life's goals are its oceans
meaning.hi: पुरुषार्थ ही सागर हैं

meaning.en: the body is an island of nine jewels
meaning.hi: देह नौ रत्नों का द्वीप है

meaning.en: the seven bodily layers with countless intentions are wishing-trees
meaning.hi: त्वचादि सात धातुएँ संकल्पों सहित कल्पवृक्ष हैं

meaning.en: its radiance is the garden where they grow
meaning.hi: तेज ही कल्पक-उद्यान है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the six tastes known by the tongue are its six seasons
meaning.hi: जीभ के छह रस ही इसकी छह ऋतुएँ हैं

meaning.en: the power to act is its seat
meaning.hi: क्रियाशक्ति ही पीठ है

meaning.en: Kundalini, the power of knowledge, is her house
meaning.hi: कुंडलिनी ज्ञानशक्ति उसका घर है

meaning.en: the power of wanting is Tripurasundari
meaning.hi: इच्छाशक्ति महात्रिपुरसुंदरी है

words.sanskrit: jnata hota jnanam agnih jneyam havih

meaning.en: the knower is the fire of knowing, the known is the offering
meaning.hi: ज्ञाता होता, ज्ञान अग्नि, ज्ञेय हवि है

meaning.en: worship of the Shri Chakra is realizing knower, knowing, and known are not separate
meaning.hi: ज्ञाता-ज्ञान-ज्ञेय के अभेद का भाव ही श्रीचक्र-पूजन है

meaning.en: the nine delights arise in order, giving the eight lesser powers such as minuteness
meaning.hi: नियति सहित शृंगारादि नौ रस अणिमादि शक्तियाँ हैं

meaning.en: desire, anger, greed, delusion, pride, envy, merit, and wrongdoing are the eight forms of Brahmi and her companions
meaning.hi: काम, क्रोध, लोभ, मोह, मद, मत्सर्य, पुण्य, पाप ब्राह्मी आदि आठ शक्तियाँ हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: earth, water, fire, air, and space
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी, जल, अग्नि, वायु, आकाश

meaning.en: hearing, touch, sight, taste, and smell
meaning.hi: श्रोत्र, त्वक्, चक्षु, जिह्वा, घ्राण

meaning.en: speech, hand, foot, and the organs of action
meaning.hi: वाक्, पाणि, पाद आदि कर्मेंद्रियाँ

meaning.en: the mind's changing moods such as longing; sixteen powers altogether
meaning.hi: मन के विकार जैसे कामाकर्षिणी आदि सोलह शक्तियाँ

meaning.en: speech, grasping, moving, releasing, joy, withdrawal, indifference, awareness: the eight powers of desire's flower
meaning.hi: वचन, आदान, गमन, विसर्ग, आनंद, हान, उपादान, उपेक्षा-बुद्धि अनंगकुसुमादि आठ शक्तियाँ

words.sanskrit: alambusa kuhu vishvodari varuna hastijihva yashasvati ashvini gandhari pusha shankhini sarasvati ida pingala sushumna iti chaturdasha nadyah

meaning.en: the fourteen subtle channels, Alambusa, Kuhu and the rest, including Ida, Pingala and Sushumna
meaning.hi: अलम्बुसा, कुहू, विश्वोदरी आदि सहित इड़ा, पिंगला, सुषुम्ना — चौदह नाड़ियाँ

meaning.en: the fourteen deities who stir the body's parts into motion
meaning.hi: सर्वसंक्षोभिण्यादि चौदह अरगत देवताएँ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Prana, Apana, Vyana, Udana, Samana, and five lesser breaths: the ten winds
meaning.hi: प्राण, अपान, व्यान, उदान, समान आदि दस वायु

meaning.en: goddesses granting every accomplishment stand at the outer ends of these ten channels
meaning.hi: सर्वसिद्धिप्रदा देवियाँ बाह्य दस अरग देवताएँ

meaning.en: breathing out, absorbing, drying, burning, lifting: five main functions of the vital fire
meaning.hi: रेचक, पूरक, शोषक, दाहक, प्लावक प्राणमुख्य पाँच क्रियाएँ

words.sanskrit: ksharako darakah kshobhako mohako jrimbhaka iti apalana-mukhyatvena panchavidhah

meaning.en: corroding, splitting, agitating, confusing, and yawning govern the body's upkeep
meaning.hi: क्षारक, दारक, क्षोभक, मोहक, जृंभक पालनमुख्य पाँच क्रियाएँ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the confusing, burning winds cook food of four kinds, chewed, eaten, sucked, and drunk
meaning.hi: मोहक-दाहक चार प्रकार के अन्न को पचाते हैं

words.sanskrit: eta dasha vahni-kalah sarvajnatva-adi antah-dasha-arga devatah

meaning.en: these ten fires of digestion are themselves goddesses present at every stage of knowing
meaning.hi: ये दस वह्निकलाएँ सर्वज्ञत्वादि दस अंतरारग देवताएँ हैं

meaning.en: cold, heat, joy, sorrow, desire, and the three gunas are the eight powers headed by Vashini
meaning.hi: शीत, उष्ण, सुख, दुख, इच्छा, सत्त्व-रज-तम गुण वशिन्यादि आठ शक्तियाँ

meaning.en: sound, touch, form, taste, smell are the five subtle essences, the five flower-arrows
meaning.hi: शब्द, स्पर्श, रूप, रस, गंध पाँच तन्मात्राएँ, पाँच पुष्पबाण

meaning.en: the mind is the sugarcane bow
meaning.hi: मन इक्षुधनुष है

words.sanskrit: vashyah vanah ragah pashah dveshah ankushah

meaning.en: attachment is the bowstring, longing the noose, aversion the goad
meaning.hi: वश्य वाण, राग पाश, द्वेष अंकुश

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the unmanifest, the great principle, and the sense of I appear as Kameshvari, Vajreshvari, and Bhagamalini at the tip of the inner triangle
meaning.hi: अव्यक्त, महत्तत्त्व, अहंकार कामेश्वरी-वज्रेश्वरी-भगमालिनी त्रिकोणाग्रगा देवता हैं

meaning.en: Kameshvara is pure, unconditioned awareness itself
meaning.hi: निरुपाधिक संवित् ही कामेश्वर है

meaning.en: Lalita, the supreme deity, is one's own self, whole and ever blissful
meaning.hi: सदानंदपूर्ण स्वात्मा ही परदेवता ललिता है

meaning.en: reflecting on all of this is called insight
meaning.hi: इस सबका विमर्श ही लौहित्य है

meaning.en: perfection comes from a mind fixed on nothing else
meaning.hi: अनन्यचित्तता से ही सिद्धि है

meaning.en: the act growing from that inner feeling is true worship
meaning.hi: भावना की क्रिया ही उपचार है

words.sanskrit: aham tvam asti nasti kartavyam-akartavyam upasitavyam iti vikalpanam atmani vilapanam homah

meaning.en: dissolving I and you, being and not-being, duty and non-duty into the self is the fire-offering
meaning.hi: मैं-तुम, अस्ति-नास्ति, कर्तव्य-अकर्तव्य विकल्पों का आत्मा में विलय ही होम है

meaning.en: feeling the sameness of everything experienced is the libation
meaning.hi: भावना-विषयों की अभेद-भावना ही तर्पण है

meaning.en: the fifteen Nitya goddesses are the changing phases of time seen as the fifteen lunar days
meaning.hi: पंद्रह तिथिरूप से काल-परिणाम का अवलोकन ही पंद्रह नित्याएँ हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: faith-shaped understanding is itself the deity
meaning.hi: श्रद्धानुरूपा बुद्धि ही देवता है

meaning.en: Kameshvari, dense with unbroken bliss, the oneness of one's own complete self, is chief
meaning.hi: कामेश्वरी सदानंदघना पूर्णस्वात्मैक्यरूपा प्रमुख देवता है

meaning.en: water represents the steadiness giving rise to that reddish glow
meaning.hi: जल लौहित्य का कारण सत्त्व है

meaning.en: weighing duty against non-duty is the inner offering
meaning.hi: कर्तव्य-अकर्तव्य की भावना ही उपचार है

meaning.en: seeing existence and non-existence as duties is a lesser offering
meaning.hi: अस्ति-नास्ति कर्तव्यता ही अनुपचार है

meaning.en: the mind's readiness to take on any form is the invitation
meaning.hi: बाह्याभ्यंतःकरणों की रूपग्रहण-योग्यता ही आवाहन है

meaning.en: settling on one object is the seat prepared
meaning.hi: एकरूप विषयग्रहण ही आसन है

meaning.en: blending red and white is the water for washing the feet
meaning.hi: रक्त-शुक्ल पदों का ऐक्य ही पाद्य है

meaning.en: offering a bright, blissful seat is the welcome-water
meaning.hi: उज्ज्वल आनंद-आसन-दान ही अर्घ्य है

meaning.en: clear, self-existent water is the purifying sip
meaning.hi: स्वच्छ स्वतःसिद्ध जल ही आचमनीय है

meaning.en: being flooded with awareness like moonlight is the ritual bath
meaning.hi: चित्-चंद्रमयी सर्वांग-स्रवण ही स्नान है

meaning.en: the flash of highest bliss, as conscious fire, is the sacred garment
meaning.hi: चिदग्निस्वरूप परमानंद-शक्ति-स्फुरण ही वस्त्र है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: broken into twenty-seven kinds through will, knowledge, and action, this forms the sacred thread strung along Brahman's channel
meaning.hi: इच्छा-ज्ञान-क्रियात्मक सत्ताईस भेदों से बना ब्रह्मसूत्र

meaning.en: remembering nothing outside oneself is worth grasping is the ornament
meaning.hi: स्व-व्यतिरिक्त वस्तु-संगरहित स्मरण ही आभूषण है

meaning.en: remembering the fullness of being, awareness, and joy is the fragrance
meaning.hi: सच्चित्सुख-परिपूर्णता-स्मरण ही गंध है

meaning.en: holding the mind steady on every object is the flower offered
meaning.hi: समस्त विषयों का स्थैर्यपूर्वक अनुसंधान ही कुसुम है

meaning.en: owning that steadiness again and again is the incense
meaning.hi: उसका सतत स्वीकरण ही धूप है

meaning.en: the self shining on its own, wrapped in wind like a spark filling the sky, is the lamp
meaning.hi: वायु-आवृत ऊर्ध्वज्वलन सच्चिदुल्का आकाशदेह ही दीप है

meaning.en: standing free of all coming and going is the food offered
meaning.hi: समस्त यातायात-वर्जन ही नैवेद्य है

meaning.en: merging the three states of experience into one is the betel leaf
meaning.hi: तीनों अवस्थाओं का एकीकरण ही ताम्बूल है

words.sanskrit: muladharat a-brahmarandhra-paryantam brahmarandhrat a-muladhara-paryantam gatagata-rupena pradakshinyam

meaning.en: moving from the spine's base to the crown and back is the circling walk
meaning.hi: मूलाधार से ब्रह्मरंध्र तक और वापस गतागत ही प्रदक्षिणा है

meaning.en: resting in the fourth state beyond waking, dream, and sleep is the final bow
meaning.hi: तुरीय अवस्था ही नमस्कार है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: sinking into the state of a bodiless witness is the true sacrifice
meaning.hi: देहशून्य-प्रमातृता-निमज्जन ही बलिहरण है

meaning.en: accepting truth, beyond right and wrong, unmoved, dissolving into the eternal, is the fire-offering
meaning.hi: सत्य-कर्तव्य-अकर्तव्य-औदासीन्य-नित्यात्मविलापन ही होम है

meaning.en: settling completely at the Guru's feet in unbroken meditation is the highest practice
meaning.hi: गुरु-पादुका में पूर्ण निमज्जन ही परिपूर्ण ध्यान है

words.sanskrit: evam muhurta-trayam muhurta-dvitayam muhurta-matram va bhavana-parah jivanmuktah bhavati sa eva shiva-yogi iti gadyate

meaning.en: staying absorbed for three, two, or even one short spell makes one free while living, called a Shiva Yogi
meaning.hi: तीन, दो या एक मुहूर्त भावनापर रहने वाला जीवन्मुक्त शिवयोगी कहलाता है

meaning.en: meditating on the inner chakras by this understanding, one realizes the oneness of self and deity
meaning.hi: आदिमत से अंतश्चक्र-भावना से देवतात्मैक्य-सिद्धि होती है

meaning.en: whatever such a person wishes for happens effortlessly
meaning.hi: चिंतित कार्य अयत्न से सिद्ध होते हैं

words.sanskrit: kadi-hadi-matoktena bhavana pratipadita jivanmukto bhavati ya evam veda iti upanishat

meaning.en: both major streams teach this; one who knows this becomes free while living, so says this Upanishad
meaning.hi: कादि-हादि मत से यही भावना प्रतिपादित; जो जानता है वह जीवन्मुक्त होता है, यह उपनिषद है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
